troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting: Dropped Frames
troubleshooting.shortdesc: The stream stutters, or the status bar reports dropped frames.

condition.p: OBS Studio's status bar shows a percentage of frames dropped, and the resulting stream or recording stutters or skips.

cause.p: Rendering frames dropped: the CPU or GPU cannot keep up with the chosen output resolution, frame rate, or number of active sources and filters.

step.cmd: Lower the output resolution or frame rate in Settings > Video.
Reduce the number of active filters, especially GPU-intensive ones like Chroma Key at high resolution.
Switch to a hardware encoder if currently using software (x264) encoding.

cause.p: Network frames dropped: the configured bitrate exceeds what the upload connection can sustain, so the network buffer overflows and frames are discarded before they reach the streaming service.

step.cmd: Run a real-world upload speed test, not just the number advertised by your ISP.
Lower the streaming bitrate in Settings > Output to comfortably below your measured upload speed.
Enable Automatically reconnect and a dynamic bitrate option if your encoder supports it.
